```{r}
 if (!requireNamespace("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE))
        install.packages("BiocManager")
    BiocManager::install("ShortRead")
```

```{r}
 library(ShortRead)
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
fastq_directory_k1 <- "~/Downloads/CIB_raw/combined/Raw Data 2020-22/Kenai_run_1" 
fastq_directory_k2 <- "~/Downloads/CIB_raw/combined/Raw Data 2020-22/Kenai_run_2" 
fastq_directory_k3 <- "~/Downloads/CIB_raw/combined/Raw Data 2020-22/Kenai_run_3" 
fastq_directory_t2 <- "~/Downloads/CIB_raw/combined/Raw Data 2020-22/Twentymile River seqrun2" 
fastq_directory_t1 <- "~/Downloads/CIB_raw/combined/Raw Data 2020-22/seq_run_1/Zack_beluga"



```

```{r}
read_counts_k1 <- countFastq(dirPath = fastq_directory_k1, pattern = ".fastq$|.fastq.gz$")
read_counts_k2 <- countFastq(dirPath = fastq_directory_k2, pattern = ".fastq$|.fastq.gz$")
read_counts_k3 <- countFastq(dirPath = fastq_directory_k3, pattern = ".fastq$|.fastq.gz$")
read_counts_t2 <- countFastq(dirPath = fastq_directory_t2, pattern = ".fastq$|.fastq.gz$")
read_counts_t1 <- countFastq(dirPath = fastq_directory_t1, pattern = ".fastq$|.fastq.gz$")

rbind(read_counts_k1,read_counts_k2,read_counts_k3, read_counts_t2, read_counts_t1) %>% 
  mutate(., All="All") %>% 
  rownames_to_column(var = "ID") %>% 
  filter(., str_detect(ID,"R1_001.fastq.gz")) %>% 
  group_by(All) %>% 
  dplyr::summarise(sum(records))
```
